start: Owner signed in, Visits page, register for today, members with running plans

steps.action: Open Visits
user_sees: Title 'Visits', 'Who trained, and when'
Tabs with 'Losing the habit' and its count
'Check someone in' with 'Day' and the box 'Type a name or the last 4 digits of a mobile'
must_not: Members of another branch in the list
A future day offered

steps.action: Type the last 4 digits of a member's mobile and tap the member
user_sees: Toast '<name> checked in.'
The member under 'Check-ins today' with the time
The count tiles go up by one
must_not: A second visit for the same member and day from a double tap
A check-in for a member whose plan ended shown with no warning
The visit dated on another day

steps.action: Tap 'Undo check-in for <name>'
user_sees: Toast 'Check-in removed for <name>.' and the counts go back
must_not: The wrong member's visit removed
A check-in made in the member app removed with no word that it came from the app

start: Owner opens Visits > 'Losing the habit' from the tab (or the Today tile)

steps.action: Open the tab
user_sees: Subtitle 'Paying members who are losing the habit'
Tiles per band and cards with the reason, 'Usually <hour>', 'Last visit <n> weeks ago' and a WhatsApp link
must_not: A member listed only because the desk never added visits
Pass members or members with no running plan listed as at risk

steps.action: Tap the WhatsApp link on a card
user_sees: WhatsApp opens on that member's number with nothing sent yet
must_not: A message sent by itself
Another member's number

steps.action: Tap the Excel download
user_sees: 'Exported <n> members.' with columns Member, Mobile, Batch, Status, Last visit, Days since visit, Visits in last 8 weeks, Why
must_not: 'Exported 1 members.'
A file with more people than the list shown

start: Owner opens Check-in QR (poster) and Pass visits

steps.action: Open Check-in QR
user_sees: Title 'Check-in QR', 'Members scan it with the MettleUp app and check themselves in'
'Scan to check in' with the QR, print and save-as-picture buttons
'Members need the MettleUp app, and must join your gym in it (gym code <code>). The join poster is in Settings → Invite members.'
must_not: A QR of another gym or branch
'Poster saved as a picture.' when no file was made (then 'Could not make the picture. Try Print poster.')

steps.action: Open Pass visits and pick a month
user_sees: 'Pass visits' and 'Pass members who came' tiles
'Visits by pass company' table and 'Who came on a pass'
'Download Excel file' then 'Exported <n> pass visits.'
must_not: Visits of normal members counted as pass visits
A pass member shown with dues or on the renewal list

steps.action: Set 'Register date' to tomorrow
user_sees: 'That day hasn’t happened yet.' and 'Pick a day first' 'Pick a day that has already passed. Then the check-in box comes back.'
must_not: A visit saved in the future

steps.action: Search a name nobody has
user_sees: 'Nobody matches that' 'Check the spelling, or add them in Members first.'
must_not: A blank list with no words

steps.action: Tap a member already checked in today
user_sees: The row shows they are already in; no second visit
must_not: Two visits on one day

steps.action: Open Check-in QR in a gym that is not online
user_sees: 'Put your gym online first' 'Members check in from their own phone, so your gym must be online first. Go to Settings → Sign-in & data. Then come back here for the poster.'
must_not: A poster that cannot work

start: Owner adds a missed day, and a member scans the poster meanwhile

steps.action: Set 'Register date' to last Monday and check two members in
user_sees: 'Adding check-ins for <day>'
Both listed under 'Check-ins on <day>'
must_not: The visits saved on today
The 30-day chart unchanged

steps.action: A member scans the poster with the app
user_sees: After a refresh the member is in today's list with a tag that it came from the app
must_not: The desk's own check-in of the same member today doubled by the scan

steps.action: A new gym with no visits opens 'Losing the habit'
user_sees: 'Start checking members in' 'This list needs a few days of check-ins first. … Nobody is listed just because their visits were never added.'
must_not: Every member listed as gone quiet

start: Owner exports the at-risk list; a member waits at the poster with a number not on file

steps.action: Download the at-risk Excel
user_sees: Names and mobile numbers of this gym's members only
must_not: Members of another branch or gym
A cell starting with + read as a formula

steps.action: A member whose phone is not linked scans the poster
user_sees: The app asks the member's number only the first time; the desk sees a request to approve
must_not: The member checked in under another member's name without the desk approving
